Name: Sebastian is a Ginger
Author: melkat7
AuthorLabel: Oh great katfish it is I melkat7
Description:
Have you ever wondered why Robin and Sebastian look nothing alike? Have you suspected that hiding under our favorite angsty bachelor's hair dye are brilliant reds and oranges? Are you sick of Sebby looking like he never graduated from the middle school emo scene? Are you ready to see Sebby in a way you never wanted? Do you want his hair to assault your eyes and match your farm (more then his purple emo hair anyways)? Well then this is the mod for you, that no one asked for!

[img width=522,height=299]http://i.imgur.com/BhxWASY.png[/img]

There are a few different flavors of this mod because I have too much time on my hands:

[b]*Complete* Edits:[/b]
"Just Ginger Sebby" is simply that, no portrait outfit or overworld sprite changes besides the ginger hair~
"Ginger V-Neck" is ginger Sebby with ginger hair AND...you guessed it, a grey v-neck. His overworld sprite's outfit has also been edited~!
"Original Black Hair V-Neck" is just good ole vanilla hair Sebby BUT with the grey v-neck on his portrait and overworld sprite. Perfect for spring and summer!

(Note I also shortened Sebby's hair in his overworld sprite a tad. His hair aint THAT long)

[b]Only Portraits Edits:[/b]

There are 3 portrait only edits (I'll do the overworld sprite ones sometime maybe) for both ginger sebby and regular vanilla-hair sebby

"Green Shirt" is a noice green collared shirt
"Black Shirt" is a black collared shirt with a purple t-shirt
"Black Necklace + Black Shirt" is the same black shirt as above wiiiiiiith a black chocker (He looks like male sam manson, just, don't ask, but it exists)




[b]To Easily Install:

[/b](Pro tip: Make sure you have backups of your portaits and characters file just in case!)

[b]~Portraits~[/b]
1)Extract and then simply replace the Sebastian.xnb file located in your stardew valley contents > [b]portraits[/b] folder with mine

[b]~Overworld Sprites~[/b]
1)Extract and then simply replace the Sebastian.xnb file located in your stardew valley contents > [b]characters[/b] folder with mine

~*Also reminder that you can only install one at a time, so pick and choose which you'd like to use! You can always swap them out if you get bored ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)*~




[b]I'll probably make more, and if YOU have any particular outfits you'd love to see Sebby in, feel free to pm/comment and maybe it's something I'd love too!

[/b](This is also my first mod, there shouldn't be anything wrong/not working but if there is, please let me know and I'll do my best to fix it!)
